reasoning: This commit rewrote Alarms.init() to iterate over alarms and call enable(alarm.getId(), false) for each expired-but-disabled alarm. That call chain led to changeAlarm() being invoked once per alarm during init (triggering repeated setNextAlert()/notifyAlarmListChangedListeners() calls and DB writes with unnecessary set.remove/set.add), which is the exact issue the "small refactoring" fix commit addresses by replacing the enable() call in init() with a lightweight alarm.setEnabled(false) + writeToDb(alarm.getId()) that avoids the heavy side effects. The buggy line "enable(alarm.getId(), false);" inside init() was directly introduced by this commit.
